name: FrankEver Sprinkler Controller FK-06X
summary: Third-party 6-zone 24VAC Wi-Fi/Bluetooth sprinkler controller with Shelly-style local API and MQTT.

extra.weather: historical weather data to skip overwatering

gotchas: 6 zones max, 24VAC valves only, 2 A total adapter budget — not for larger or DC-latching valve systems
Scripting: No (unlike native Shelly Gen2+ devices) — automation limited to schedules/webhooks/MQTT
Schedules go inactive if date/time isn't synced — needs Wi-Fi + internet for time
Third-party (Frankever) hardware; confirm the US 120V/60Hz adapter variant ships for US use
best_for: replacing a ≤6-zone 24VAC residential irrigation timer with local/MQTT control
